description: Descriptor of a VBA macro project preserved verbatim (node type core.sheet.vba-project). The project is the file of this node with role `project` (`vbaProject.bin`), byte for byte as it was in the source .xlsm file: a Compound File Binary container holding the VBA project storage. Both are DEFINED in this package: `meta.file_formats.project` of this node is `ovba`, and `formats.ovba` / `formats.cfb` in MANIFEST.json give the paths of the definitions (spec/formats/ovba.md, which builds on spec/formats/cfb.md). From them a reader can list the modules and recover the source text of every module; a reference reader travels as the tool node `format-ovba-reference`. GridCraft does not run macros; the project is kept so that saving a macro-enabled workbook does not destroy its macros.

file_name.description: The file of this node that holds the project: the one whose path ends in `/vbaProject.bin`.

format.description: The format id of `vbaProject.bin`: a key of the `formats` map in MANIFEST.json.

never_auto_execute.description: ALWAYS true, and not a switch: this node carries EMBEDDED CODE. A consumer MUST NOT execute, load, compile or interpret it automatically - not on open, not on preview, not on any event. Reading it as data (listing modules, showing source text) is not executing it. Running it is a deliberate act of a person who has inspected it, outside this format.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the project's bytes.

size.description: Size of the project in bytes.

title: core.sheet.vba-project - a VBA project preserved verbatim, never executed
